purpose: Pin nine major formula slots to exact source repositories and commits for the Z-stereo ninefold experiment.
normalization_note: The nine formulas do not share a common input/output type. Z routing must carry typed envelopes and an explicit normalization contract before any 9->3->1 numerical recombination is considered meaningful.

slots.name: Pell rank family
slots.status: explicit corollary of classical Pell/Lucas rank-lifting results

slots.name: Pell odd-exponent square specialization
slots.status: specialization of F1; not an independent proof channel

slots.name: Connected-spectrum sample generator
slots.input_contract: finite empirical Brutus-Pell sample, cutoff Q, scalar/formal u, centered normalized Z_q

slots.name: Connected logarithmic generator
slots.input_contract: S_Q(u) plus complete finite-sample pair moments p_qr = E[Z_q Z_r]

slots.name: Connected coefficient K3
slots.status: coefficient identity inside the archived finite-sample expansion

slots.name: Connected coefficient K4
slots.input_contract: finite-sample T2, T4 and complete pair moments p_qr
slots.status: coefficient identity inside the archived finite-sample expansion

slots.name: Connected coefficient K5
slots.status: coefficient identity inside the archived finite-sample expansion

slots.name: Connected coefficient K6
slots.input_contract: finite-sample T2, T3, T4, T6 and complete pair moments p_qr
slots.status: coefficient identity inside the archived finite-sample expansion

slots.name: Brutus frozen V1 numerical relation
slots.input_contract: frozen constants exactly as declared in V1
slots.output_contract: dimensionless numerical value unless an external unit convention is explicitly supplied
slots.status: reproducible frozen candidate relation; physical interpretation not established

guardrails: F2 is mathematically dependent on F1 and must not be counted as independent verification.
F3 through F8 share the same connected-spectrum source family and must not be counted as independent proofs of one another.
F9 numerical reproducibility does not establish the proposed physical interpretation.
No common scalar recombination is authorized until typed normalization rules are declared and tested.
